title: For Philippine market: Updates to Mandatory Attributes on Chair Categories
breadcrumb: For Philippine market: Updates to Mandatory Attributes on Chair Categories
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2026-06-07
html:
What is changing?

Starting from 4 August 2026, partners will be required to provide mandatory product attributes when listing or editing products by using API under the following categories: Chairs 876040, Outdoor Chairs 877704 and Chairs 879624. The mandatory product attributes will include :

  • Material / 100701
  • If "Material = Plastic"", "PS/ICC No. / 101073” is mandatory.

Which markets are affected?

The updates of the requirements apply to local to local and cross border sellers in the Philippine market.

Who is affected?

Developers with applications that use Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product

Which version is applicable?

The updates of the requirements apply to all versions of the related APIs

What action is required?

Without this mandatory attribute sellers will not be able to create and update products. Use the Get Attributes to check what attributes are mandatory and pass attribute values via the Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product to help sellers fill in the attribute values.
